hotel_name: Anantara Al Jabal Al Akhdar Resort

claims.text: The resort is set high in the Al Hajar Mountains.

findings.quote: Set high in the Al Hajar Mountains, the resort offers breathtaking canyon views

claims.text: The resort is on the Green Mountain, about two hours' drive inland from Muscat, with dramatic canyon views.

findings.quote: Escape to cool mountain climes two hours' drive inland from Muscat. Located on the fabled Green Mountain, elevated luxury reveals dramatic canyon views

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as sitting on the rim of a canyon in the Al Hajar mountains.

findings.quote: Set in the sunburnt Al-Hajar mountains, on the rim of the Arabian Peninsula’s most outrageously beautiful canyon

claims.text: All rooms look out onto the canyon and have balconies.

findings.quote: All rooms look out onto the dramatic canyon, with comfortable balconies for viewing pleasure.

claims.text: Rooms have a dressing room and a spa-like bathroom.

findings.quote: Dressing room and a spa-like bathroom

claims.text: Villas come with Villa Host service.

findings.quote: Villa Host service

claims.text: The Anantara Spa offers traditional Thai healing and wellness journeys.

findings.quote: Anantara Spa with traditional Thai healing and wellness journeys

claims.text: Guests can unwind with spa and hammam rituals.

findings.quote: Unwind at our Oman resort with spa and hammam rituals.

claims.text: The resort has temperature-controlled swimming pools and a fitness centre.

findings.quote: temperature-controlled swimming pools, an award-winning spa, a fitness centre

claims.text: Children can enjoy the Kids' Club and outdoor activities.

findings.quote: children can enjoy the Kids' Club and outdoor activities

claims.text: The resort has five dining venues, including dining overlooking the canyon.

findings.quote: The resort offers five distinctive dining venues, ranging from international and regional cuisine to unforgettable dining experiences overlooking the dramatic canyon landscape.

claims.text: Nearby, guests can explore hiking trails, traditional mountain villages and terraced farms.

findings.quote: scenic hiking trails, traditional mountain villages, terraced farms

claims.text: Guests can stargaze from the viewing platform where Princess Diana once stood.

findings.quote: Stargaze from the viewing platform where Princess Diana once stood.

claims.text: Villas have one, two or three bedrooms and a private pool, set in garden surrounds or with an infinity view across the canyon.

findings.quote: One, two and three bedrooms
Slip into your private pool in exotic garden surrounds, or with an infinity view across the canyon.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel has the highest swimming pools, tennis court and stargazing platform in the Middle East.

findings.quote: The hotel has the highest swimming pools, tennis court, and stargazing platform in the Middle East.

claims.text: Signature experiences include sunrise yoga, cliff-edge dining, wellness journeys, stargazing and cultural experiences.

findings.quote: including sunrise yoga, cliff-edge dining, wellness journeys, stargazing and authentic cultural experiences

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes chasm-facing pool villas, majlis-style courtyards and a lantern-lit outdoor hookah space.

findings.quote: with chasm-facing pool villas, majlis-style courtyards, a lantern-lit outdoor hookah space

claims.text: Jabal Akhdar is reached through a mountain checkpoint, and a 4WD vehicle is required.

findings.quote: As Jabal Akhdar is accessed via a mountain checkpoint, a 4WD vehicle is required.

claims.text: The resort is approximately 2.5 hours by car from Muscat International Airport.

findings.quote: The resort is approximately 2.5 hours by car from Muscat International Airport.
